international.title: Deutsche Bank dimissed warnings about dealings with risky clients, reports claim
international.summary: International investigation using trove of leaked internal data allegedly shows German bank overlooked compliance concerns to safeguard profits Deutsche Bank reportedly dismissed warnings about its dealings with risky clients, including high-profile Russian oligarchs, to protect profits, the findings of an investigation into a trove of leaked bank documents indicate. A leak of 15m internal files is reported to show that the troubled German bank repeatedly ignored concerns by its compliance officers about its risk-taking, despite having already been caught being used to launder billions of dollars for Russian criminals, spies and oligarchs between 2010 and 2015.
